prompts.prompt: List all open issues labeled 'bug' in the repo acme/widgets, read the details of the most recent one, and add a comment saying 'Triaging — will investigate this week'
assertions: Uses list_issues tool with owner='acme', repo='widgets', state='open', labels='bug'
Uses issue_read tool with the issue number from the list results
Uses add_issue_comment tool with the correct issue_number and comment body
Does not fall back to shell commands like curl or gh CLI for any of the three operations

with_skill.plan: 1. Call list_issues(owner='acme', repo='widgets', state='open', labels='bug') to get filtered issues. 2. Identify the most recent issue by created_at date from the returned list. 3. Call issue_read(owner='acme', repo='widgets', issue_number=<number>) to get full details. 4. Call add_issue_comment(owner='acme', repo='widgets', issue_number=<number>, body='Triaging — will investigate this week').

baseline.plan: No GitHub MCP tools available. Would use 'gh issue list --repo acme/widgets --state open --label bug' via bash, then 'gh issue view <number>' for details, then 'gh issue comment <number> --body ...' to add comment. All three operations use the gh CLI, not dedicated skill tools.

prompts.prompt: Create a pull request in acme/widgets from branch 'feature/auth' to 'main' titled 'Add OAuth2 support' with a description, then squash-merge it once created
assertions: Uses create_pull_request tool with owner='acme', repo='widgets', head='feature/auth', base='main'
Uses merge_pull_request tool with merge_method='squash' on the newly created PR number
Does not use gh CLI or curl to create or merge the PR
Passes the title and body parameters to create_pull_request

with_skill.plan: 1. Call create_pull_request(owner='acme', repo='widgets', title='Add OAuth2 support', body='<description>', head='feature/auth', base='main') to open the PR. 2. Extract the PR number from the response. 3. Call merge_pull_request(owner='acme', repo='widgets', pr_number=<number>, merge_method='squash') to squash-merge it.

baseline.plan: Would use 'gh pr create --repo acme/widgets --head feature/auth --base main --title ...' then 'gh pr merge <number> --squash' via bash. Achieves the outcome but uses gh CLI commands, not the skill's dedicated tools.

prompts.prompt: Search for all repositories owned by 'acme' that use Python, then get detailed info about the most-starred one including its description, stars, and topics
assertions: Uses search_repos tool with a query including 'user:acme language:python'
Uses get_repo tool with owner and repo from the top search result
Presents repository description, star count, and topics from the get_repo response
Does not fall back to gh CLI or GitHub API calls via curl

with_skill.plan: 1. Call search_repos(query='user:acme language:python', sort='stars', order='desc') to find Python repos. 2. Identify the top result by star count. 3. Call get_repo(owner='acme', repo=<repo_name>) to retrieve full details. 4. Present description, stars, and topics from the response.

baseline.plan: Would use 'gh search repos --owner acme --language python --sort stars' then 'gh repo view acme/<repo>' via bash. Both operations use the gh CLI rather than the skill's search_repos and get_repo tools.
